entities.summary: Butler Riots and the Labour Movement, a transformative movement in Trinidad and Tobago (1937–1950). Emerged from Butler Riots — June 19, 1937 — oilfield strikes escalate into island-wide unrest and Commercial oil production begins at Guayaguayare c. 1907. Catalyzed Universal adult suffrage granted 1946 and West Indies Federation.
